principle: Generative video may add visual imagination, never factual evidence.

classes.label: Factual evidence
classes.rule: Use verified real media only. If unavailable, report the media gap or redesign the scene without pretending to show the fact.

classes.label: Factual overlay
classes.rule: Render deterministically in Remotion/HTML/SVG using validated facts and the active Design System. Never bake factual text into AI video.

classes.label: Conceptual illustration
classes.rule: May use generative video if the scene is not presented as documentary evidence and does not impersonate official assets.

classes.label: Controlled image-to-video
examples: approved illustration animated with camera motion
designed first frame brought to life
classes.rule: Preferred generative mode when composition, identity and key geometry must remain controlled. First frame must be approved for the intended semantic role.

classes.label: Transition-only generative clip
classes.rule: Keep short, semantically neutral and free of factual claims. Deterministic layers must handle official identity and text.

preflight: Classify every proposed AI-generated scene before generation.
Reject any prompt that asks the model to fabricate documentary evidence or an official asset.
Prefer image-to-video over text-to-video when an approved first frame can constrain composition.
Keep logos, legal text, names, routes, prices, phone numbers and metrics outside the generated pixels.
Record provider, model, prompt, source frame, generation date and review status for every retained clip.
Do not promote a generated clip from review to approved without human visual review.
If the generated scene could reasonably be mistaken for a real event or location, label/redesign it as illustrative or do not use it.
